description: CONCEPT FIDELITY — Lantern Cloister, rendered live in WebGL from the same parameters.
notes: Simulation-identical to `concept_lantern_cloister` and to `_baked`. See that room's notes.
This one is `render/room-webgl-lab.ts`: the blockout's geometry rebuilt on the GPU every
frame through the runtime's own projection, so a parameter change costs a reload instead of a
Blender render and an export. The baked room is still what ships.
